name: Eighty-One
description: Eighty-One was a BX-series droid commando hunter who was hired by Wilhuff Tarkin to hunt Darth Vader, on Chandar's Folly. Eighty-One stole Vader's lightsaber after it proved to be deadly against Tarkin's team. However, when Vader later led the group into a cavern, he ambushed the hunters and pounced on Eighty-One from above, destroying the droid.
